title: Replica Quorum Version
brief: A distributed key-value store asks every replica which schema version it is running. Rollouts are only considered settled when one version is reported by more than half of the replicas, and the coordinator needs to know which version that is.
Implement dominantReplicaVersion(nums), where nums holds the version number reported by each replica, and return the version reported by more than half of them.
